name: Marek — has genuinely outgrown the wing
summary: About 150 hours over four seasons, flying weekly in season, 40-odd hours in the last 12 months, over 100 hours on his current low-B. Thermals confidently, has had a big asymmetric and flew it out, practises tip folds himself. His instructor has suggested the move. Wants more glide for longer cross-country flights.
why_this_persona: The clear Ready case. He is strong on exactly the cluster this step's evidence is about — thermalling, reading the day, active hands, collapse handling — rather than merely high-houred. Also the negative control for SIV: he has NOT done a manoeuvres course and must still come out Ready, per knowledge/disagreements.md point 1.

notes: Computed skills 94.0, psychological 95.4, total 94.7, no bonus.

Negative check — SIV: 'manoeuvre_course: no' must not cost him the Ready result. knowledge/steps/low-b-to-mid-b.md#siv records that no source links SIV to this step at all, and knowledge/disagreements.md point 1 forbids any penalty for not having done one. He also must not trigger 'collapse_training_early', because he has practised tip folds and handled a real asymmetric.

Negative check — hours are not what carries him. His in-air answers (thermalling, reading the day, active hands, collapse handling) contribute 50 of the 140 skills weight against 19 for cumulative hours. A reviewer wanting to confirm the weighting intent should re-score him with total_airtime dropped to 20_50 and confirm he stays Ready.
